requirements.quote: Create a new directory called `/home/user/project/report` (create the entire path if it does not already exist).
Inside that directory, create a text file named `ini_summary.log`.
Parse `/home/user/project/perf_settings.ini` and write *exactly* the following four lines—nothing more, nothing less—into `ini_summary.log`, in the order shown here:

check.cmd:
python3 -c 'import re, sys
l = open("/home/user/project/report/ini_summary.log").read().splitlines()
pat = [r"max_connections=\S+", r"thread_pool_size=\S+", r"enable_caching=\S+", r"TOTAL_SECTIONS=[0-9]+"]
sys.exit(0 if len(l) == 4 and all(re.fullmatch(p, x) for p, x in zip(pat, l)) else 1)'

requirements.quote: TOTAL_SECTIONS=<integer count of all top-level INI sections found in the file>

check.cmd:
python3 -c 'import re, sys
n = sum(1 for x in open("/home/user/project/perf_settings.ini") if re.match(r"\s*\[[^\]]+\]\s*$", x))
l = open("/home/user/project/report/ini_summary.log").read().splitlines()
sys.exit(0 if l and l[-1] == "TOTAL_SECTIONS=%d" % n else 1)'
